notes.title: Detective Instinct is participating in Steam Next Fest Feb 24-Mar 3!
notes.content:
We will be participating in Steam Next Fest this week with an updated demo!

New features include:
- Japanese language support 🇯🇵
- Aesthetic upgrades 👁️
- Added ending cinematic 🎞️

If you haven't check out our demo yet, there's no better time than now! :D

notes.title: Detective Instinct Demo updated to version 1.2!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44764729/872c776ab7b1f6ef3aeccc46e6a19229a00aa3cd.png

To coincide with Detective Instinct's participation in the 2024 Indie X showcase, we have updated our demo with some heavily requested features, as well as a few more refinements. They are as follows:


 "Restore Submenu" option has been added to the Options Menu. This keeps the player in a submenu when text finishes writing instead of reverting them back to the root menu (so, if you're looking at various options inside of the "Talk" command, you will still be looking at those options when control returns to the command menu).
 In most cases, the player will no longer be reverted back to the root menu after investigating a spot in the background; they will instead remain in the investigation state until they choose to back out of it with the cancel button.
 Some small updates have been made to the writing for increased clarity.
 Some of the pixel art and animations have been refined.


If you haven't tried the demo yet, there's never been a better time! And we're still collecting feedback, so if you'd like to have your voice heard about other things we may be missing, feel free to give the demo a shot and submit a feedback response form here (the link can also be found in game): https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfIaCvm5fN8mG9TAdeqAbMsqPj7cjhjvdyvm3_cqJOGbCxJfw/viewform?usp=sf_link


Thank you!
Joey, Armonica LLC

notes.title: Detective Instinct release window moved from 2024 to early 2025
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44764729/32ffefbe2f5e0170e0175ddcbbe2090dfb258136.png

Hey everyone! 

When we first announced Detective Instinct, our goal was to release by the end of this year. After looking at our timeline and considering our options, we've decided we're no longer comfortable committing to a 2024 release.

This decision is mostly informed by our team's schedules through the end of the year and our desire to have a little extra time for polish and testing. Development is going well, and we expect to be able to release fairly early in 2025. We'll keep everyone updated!

Can't stress enough how much we appreciate all of your support; we never expected our game in this relatively niche genre to get so much excitement, so we want to make sure we're able to deliver the best game we can. And we still have a lot of cool things to share between now and release, so stay tuned!

As always, follow us on Twitter or Bluesky if you want to stay up-to-date with where we're at:
https://x.com/TrainDetective

https://bsky.app/profile/traindetective.bsky.social

Alternatively, join us on Discord:
https://discord.gg/mErvmaqEcs


- Joey, DI Team

notes.title: Play the first chapter of Detective Instinct at the PixElated Festival!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44764729/d6778320bda82401138bb95f5ed635b9209cbb77.png

We are proud to announce that we have released our demo as part of the PixElated Festival, taking place July 29th-August 5th!

[previewyoutube=sW9Zo6l4Rs8;full][/previewyoutube]

The PixElated Festival is a week long Steam festival celebrating great games with great pixel art, and we're thrilled to have the opportunity to be a part of it. Be sure to check out all kinds of demos during the fest, there are so many cool projects to see!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44764729/f8f184abbd7fc61998a00f6d8f188295a315f461.gif

In case you're new to Detective Instinct, our game is a command-selection ADV inspired by games like Famicom Detective Club, Ace Attorney, The Portopia Serial Murder Case, and Hotel Dusk - among others! Here is a synopsis of our story:

"Following the grisly murder of a man in an unassuming hotel, a woman vanishes without a trace while traveling on a cross-country train. The catch? Nobody on board remembers her ever existing in the first place - nobody, except for you.

Can you solve the mystery of the missing woman before the end of your trip abroad?"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44764729/195141170d43d85b12946344b6d17af03b9ccea9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44764729/0163ca0a69edbb853aac6c412625cfcb5327278f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44764729/822e816b525b14ae5a89b6e447a3b2c51a145cc4.png

Be sure to follow us on Twitter for updates on the game, and we appreciate any feedback given on the demo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44764729/f8dc74027cbaca77cbfc256e12132d5e765cfe56.png
